#Load libraries
```{r}
library(stats)
library(factoextra)
library(tcplfit2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(MASS)
library(gridExtra)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)  

```

#SQRT Global PCA, Mahalanobis distances 
```{r}

simplified_files <- list.files(
  file.path(pipeline_output_path, "feature_results"),
  pattern = "^test_chem_cat.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)
simplified_files <- simplified_files[
  !grepl("_ft_colnames2\\.csv$", simplified_files)
]
simplified_files <- simplified_files[
  !grepl("_removed\\.csv$", simplified_files)
]

message("Found ", length(simplified_files), " feature-set files to process.")


walk(simplified_files, function(path) {

  # --- Label for output file names ---
  file_label <- basename(path) |>
    stringr::str_remove("^test_chem_well") |>
    stringr::str_remove("\\.csv$")

  if (file_label == "") file_label <- "_all_features"

  message("\n=== Processing: ", basename(path), " ===")

  # --- Load data ---
  well_data <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    as.data.frame()
  
  rownames(well_data) <- well_data[[1]]
  well_data <- well_data[, -1]

  # --- PCA ---
  pca <- prcomp(well_data, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

  scree_plot <- fviz_eig(
    pca, addlabels = TRUE, ylim = c(0, 75),
    main = paste0("Scree plot — ", file_label)
  )
  #ggsave(
   # filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Scree", file_label, ".png")),
   # plot = scree_plot, width = 20, height = 12, units = "cm"
 # )

  # Number of PCs explaining >95% variance
  cumulative_prop <- cumsum(pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  PC_95 <- length(which(cumulative_prop < 0.95)) + 1

  pca_x <- as.data.frame(pca$x)
  pca_x <- as.data.frame(cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), pca_x))

  ctrl_pc <- pca_x |>
    dplyr::filter(grepl(ctrl_group, chem))
  ctrl_pc  <- ctrl_pc[, -1]
  ctrl_mean <- apply(ctrl_pc, 2, mean)

  dat <- as.matrix(well_data) %*% pca$rotation[, 1:PC_95]
  Cov <- cov(dat)
  solved_cov <- MASS::ginv(Cov)

  # --- Mahalanobis distances ---
  mahal_dist_raw <- mahalanobis(dat, ctrl_mean[1:PC_95], solved_cov, inverted = TRUE)
  mahal_dist_df  <- as.data.frame(sqrt(mahal_dist_raw))
  colnames(mahal_dist_df) <- "mahal_dist"

  mahal_dist_df <- cbind(chem = rownames(well_data), mahal_dist_df)

  sample <- tibble(sample = as.character(mahal_dist_df$chem)) |>
    tidyr::separate(sample, c("chem", "concentration", "Well", "Plate"),
                    sep = "_", remove = TRUE)

  mahal_dist_df <- cbind(sample, mahal_dist = mahal_dist_df$mahal_dist)
  mahal_dist_df$concentration <- as.numeric(mahal_dist_df$concentration)

  mahal_dist_df <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(chem) |>
    dplyr::mutate(conc_count = length(unique(concentration)))

  mahal_ctrl_i <- mahal_dist_df |> dplyr::filter(chem == ctrl_group)

  mahal_dist_df <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::filter(conc_count > 3) |>
    rbind(mahal_ctrl_i)

  mahal_dist_df[mahal_dist_df$chem == ctrl_group, ]$concentration <- 1
  mahal_dist_df$exp <- exp_name

  # --- Per-plate Mahalanobis plots ---
  lapply(unique(mahal_dist_df$Plate), function(plate_i) {
    p <- ggplot(
      mahal_dist_df[mahal_dist_df$Plate == plate_i, ],
      aes(x = concentration, y = mahal_dist, colour = chem)
    ) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
                 linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon4") +
      geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) - mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
            ymax = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) + mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist)),
        fill = "thistle3", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5
      ) +
      scale_x_log10() +
      xlab("Concentration (\u03BCM)") + ylab("Mahalanobis Distance") +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 15)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(r = 15)),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
      ) +
      facet_wrap(vars(chem), scales = "free") +
      theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
      ggtitle(paste0("Plate ", plate_i, file_label))

    # ggsave(
    #   filename = file.path(
    #     plots, paste0("Plate_", plate_i, file_label, "_Global_Mahalanobis.png")
    #   ),
    #   plot = p, width = 50, height = 35, units = "cm"
    # )
  })

  # --- Global Mahalanobis plot ---
  p_global <- ggplot(mahal_dist_df,
                     aes(x = concentration, y = mahal_dist, colour = chem)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "maroon4") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) - mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist),
          ymax = median(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist) + mad(mahal_ctrl_i$mahal_dist)),
      fill = "thistle3", colour = NA, alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    xlab("Concentration (\u03BCM)") + ylab("Mahalanobis Distance") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(vars(chem), scales = "free") +
    theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) +
    ggtitle(paste0(exp_name, file_label))

  # ggsave(
  #   filename = file.path(plots, paste0(exp_name, file_label, "_Global_Mahalanobis.png")),
  #   plot = p_global, width = 50, height = 35, units = "cm"
  # )

  # --- tcplfit2 concentration-response & BMD ---
  test_chem_res_i <- mahal_dist_df |> dplyr::filter(chem != ctrl_group)
  chem_list_i     <- unique(test_chem_res_i$chem)

  vehicle_ctrl_i <- mahal_dist_df |>
    dplyr::filter(chem == ctrl_group) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Median = median(mahal_dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      nMad   = mad(mahal_dist, constant = 1.4826, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  conc_res_modeling_i <- function(test_chem, vc) {
    row <- list(
      conc   = as.numeric(test_chem$concentration),
      resp   = test_chem$mahal_dist,
      bmed   = vc$Median,
      cutoff = vc$nMad,
      onesd  = vc$nMad,
      name   = paste0(test_chem$chem[1]),
      assay  = "Mahalanobis distance (cutoff = 1)"
    )
    tcplfit2::concRespCore(
      row, conthits = TRUE, aicc = FALSE, force.fit = FALSE,
      bidirectional = TRUE,
      fitmodels = c("cnst", "hill", "poly1", "poly2", "pow",
                    "exp2", "exp3", "exp4", "exp5")
    )
  }

  tcpl_results_i <- lapply(chem_list_i, function(x) {
    chem_data <- test_chem_res_i |> dplyr::filter(chem == x)
    tcpl_chem  <- conc_res_modeling_i(chem_data, vehicle_ctrl_i)

    # if (!is.null(tcpl_chem$hitcall) && tcpl_chem$hitcall > 0.9) {
    #   png(file = file.path(
    #     plots, paste0(x, file_label, "_tcplfit_curves.png")
    #   ))
    #   tcplfit2::concRespPlot(
    #     tcpl_chem,
    #     ymin = min(chem_data$mahal_dist) - 5,
    #     ymax = max(chem_data$mahal_dist) + 10,
    #     draw.error.arrows = FALSE
    #   )
    #   dev.off()
    # }
    tcpl_chem
  }) |> do.call(rbind, args = _)

  tcpl_testchem_i <- tcpl_results_i |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      minDose = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      maxDose = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      removal_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        hitcall < 0.9   ~ "low_hitcall",
        is.na(bmdl)     ~ "missing_bmdl",
        is.na(bmdu)     ~ "missing_bmdu",
        TRUE            ~ "kept"
      ),
      keep = removal_reason == "kept",
      bmd  = ifelse(keep, bmd,  NA),
      bmdl = ifelse(keep, bmdl, NA),
      bmdu = ifelse(keep, bmdu, NA),
      exp_name = exp_name
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  # --- BMD plot ---
  bmd_plot <- ggplot(tcpl_testchem_i,
                     aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = name)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 6,  colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
      strip.text.x  = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    xlab("Median Best BMC (1 MAD above vehicle control) \u03BCM") +
    ylab("Chemicals") +
    ggtitle(paste0("BMD — ", file_label))

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots, paste0("Global_BMC_", file_label, ".png")),
    plot = bmd_plot, width = 40, height = 20, units = "cm"
  )

  # --- Save tcpl results table ---
write.csv(
  tcpl_testchem_i,
  file.path(
    pipeline_output_path,
    "tcplfit_results",
    paste0("tcpl_results_global_", file_label, ".csv")
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
  message("Done: ", basename(path))
})
```

]


message("Found ", length(simplified_files), " feature-set files to process.")

  mahal_dist_df$exp <- exp_name

# Per-plate Mahalanobis plots
